families.label: NPCs
families.gap: Witnesses, minor officials, rivals, debtors, and reversible crowd roles are not registered as an operating asset family.
families.next_safe_action: Define NPC role taxonomy and required fields without naming or writing final NPCs.

families.label: Artifacts
families.gap: Important motifs exist, but lifecycle, limitations, costs, first appearance, reuse, and upgrade paths are not modeled.
families.next_safe_action: Define artifact registry schema and lifecycle states without creating final item catalogs.

families.label: Techniques
families.gap: Seed technique candidates now exist, but final ability tree, move names, counters, visual effects, and realm binding are not registered.
families.next_safe_action: Promote or refine seed technique candidates only after stronger schema and counter rules are defined.

families.label: Naming
families.gap: There is no naming grammar for people, places, factions, artifacts, techniques, realms, or forbidden collisions.
families.next_safe_action: Define naming system schema and validation needs without generating final dictionaries.

families.label: State Ledger
families.gap: State ledger schema exists, but chapter-by-chapter operating state for life, debt, backlash, reputation, artifacts, relationships, and map unlocks is not complete.
families.next_safe_action: Define project state ledger extension points without tracking unreleased chapter events.

families.label: Emotional Bonds
families.gap: The mother bond is a strong anchor, but the wider network of allies, betrayals, sacrifices, and reciprocal bonds is not complete.
families.next_safe_action: Define emotional bond registry contract without generating relationship scenes.

families.label: Foreshadowing
families.gap: Foreshadowing ledger ideas exist, but setup, misdirection, reveal, and payoff lifecycle are not an operating registry.
families.next_safe_action: Define foreshadowing ledger schema without creating new plot promises.

families.label: Characters
families.gap: Core roles and protagonist anchors exist, but a reusable character engine is not complete.
families.next_safe_action: Define character registry schema and state fields without creating full character cards.

families.label: Factions
families.gap: Major institutions exist as world structure, but faction internals, interests, fears, and exploitable cracks are not productized.
families.next_safe_action: Define faction registry fields and status lifecycle without generating full faction dossiers.

next_family.label: NPCs
next_family.gap: Witnesses, minor officials, rivals, debtors, and reversible crowd roles are not registered as an operating asset family.
next_family.next_safe_action: Define NPC role taxonomy and required fields without naming or writing final NPCs.

corpus_pipeline.next_safe_action: 运行 hermes-readiness；最终创作资产与 Hermes 仍受 Owner Gate 约束。

target_family.label: NPCs
target_family.gap: Witnesses, minor officials, rivals, debtors, and reversible crowd roles are not registered as an operating asset family.
target_family.next_safe_action: Define NPC role taxonomy and required fields without naming or writing final NPCs.

creation_coverage_matrix.assessment: Long-form asset coverage is not complete; Studio v0.1 exposes the gaps instead of hiding them.

items.gap: Core roles and protagonist anchors exist, but a reusable character engine is not complete.
Witnesses, minor officials, rivals, debtors, and reversible crowd roles are not registered as an operating asset family.
Major institutions exist as world structure, but faction internals, interests, fears, and exploitable cracks are not productized.
Important motifs exist, but lifecycle, limitations, costs, first appearance, reuse, and upgrade paths are not modeled.
Seed technique candidates now exist, but final ability tree, move names, counters, visual effects, and realm binding are not registered.
There is no naming grammar for people, places, factions, artifacts, techniques, realms, or forbidden collisions.
The mother bond is a strong anchor, but the wider network of allies, betrayals, sacrifices, and reciprocal bonds is not complete.
Foreshadowing ledger ideas exist, but setup, misdirection, reveal, and payoff lifecycle are not an operating registry.
State ledger schema exists, but chapter-by-chapter operating state for life, debt, backlash, reputation, artifacts, relationships, and map unlocks is not complete.
